role: Core data types for behavioral learning loop: guardian verdicts, correction events, gap lifecycle, verification, and session metrics.
detail: Defines immutable Pydantic models for Epic 5 behavioral learning: ProposalOutcomeValue (enum: APPROVED/REJECTED/CORRECTED/EXPIRED), RejectionReasonCategory (7-value enum: insufficient_evidence/single_property_insufficient/fits_existing_type/noise_not_category/wait_for_more_observations/incorrect_naming/unspecified), GapState (lifecycle enum: DETECTED→QUEUED→ANSWERED→RESOLVED, plus SELF_RESOLVED/EXPIRED/SUPERSEDED). Core models: ProposalOutcome (immutable verdict record with optional rejection_reason_category, default timestamp=utc_now), CorrectionEvent (type split with pre-correction snapshot instance_ids_at_split, verification_window_size=10 default), VerificationResult (single post-correction classification check, confidence_of_classification range [0.0,1.0]). Event types: GapLifecycleEvent (durable storage with resolution_data dict), GapLifecycleTransitionEvent (lightweight signal), VerificationCompleteEvent (outcome in {VERIFIED,FAILED,TIMEOUT}). Session metrics: SessionSummary (frozen, 17 counters + 6 ratio fields all validated [0.0,1.0], verification_accuracy nullable), BaselineMetric (mean/variance pair), BehavioralBaseline (9 metrics across min_length=1 session_ids), BehavioralBaselineEstablishedEvent, SessionSummaryProducedEvent. No raw guardian text stored per CANON A.12.
gotchas: No raw guardian language stored per CANON A.12. verification_accuracy nullable in SessionSummary. All models frozen/immutable (ConfigDict frozen=True). GapState transitions validated by gap manager (T057), not in enum; invalid transitions raise BehavioralStorageError. resolution_data in GapLifecycleEvent unvalidated dict[str,Any]. Import constraints: only imports from cobeing.shared.types and stdlib, not layer3_knowledge or other cobeing subpackages to prevent circular deps.
